name: io.github.sumioshi/wacrew-whatsapp-mcp
title: WACrew · WhatsApp MCP server
description: WhatsApp MCP server: read chats and groups, transcribe voice notes and reply at a human pace.

environmentVariables.name: WAC_CLOUD_URL
environmentVariables.description: URL of your WACrew panel (the self-hosted collector).

environmentVariables.name: WAC_CONTAS
environmentVariables.description: Optional. More WhatsApp accounts (other WACrew panels), as name=https://login:password@address separated by spaces. Every tool then takes a 'conta' parameter.

environmentVariables.name: WAC_CONTA_NOME
environmentVariables.description: Optional. Name of the default account when there is more than one (default: principal).
